name: tunnel dislocation
domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 断裂带等作用引起隧道结构相对位移的状态。

complete_examples.text: It is concluded that tunnel dislocation shows significant dynamic influence on train running quality, and the train running speed, fault dislocation amplitude and width should be analyzed cooperatively.

Considering the tunnel dislocation in the active fault zone, a deformation mapping method to achieve the displacement transmission from the soil to the track and tunnel structures is presented, and then the influence of fault dislocation, considering train speed, single- and double-train operation, on system dynamic performance has been calculated and analyzed.
